s.note: the Festival of Fools in the square
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 eggs and 375ml milk and rest an hour. Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan. Fill half with ham and gruyere and fold, warming until melted. Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon juice and fold into quarters.

s.note: the busy Paris market below the cathedral
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast. Top half with brie and a spoon of fig jam. Top the rest with chopped tomato, torn basil and salt. Lay them out like a stall at the Paris market below the bell tower.

m.n: Bell tower beef and mushroom braise
m.how: Brown 150g diced bacon, then brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 12 peeled baby onions and 300g mushrooms and colour lightly. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 750ml beef stock, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and warm milk.

w.note: the great cathedral of Notre Dame
w.how: Melt 100g butter and cool. Whisk 2 eggs with 100g sugar and lemon zest until thick, then fold in 100g flour and the butter. Rest for an hour. Spoon into greased shell tins and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Esmeralda and her goat Djali in the Paris square
d.how: Simmer 250ml pomegranate juice with 100g caster sugar for 10 minutes until slightly syrupy, add a squeeze of lemon and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and add the juice of a quarter lime to each. Top with soda water, then slowly pour 3 tbsp of the grenadine down the side of each glass so it settles at the bottom. Serve with a spoon to stir.
